svg.title: Selected work
svg.desc: 01 Concreat Rewards (applications): A rewards portal where partners earn points per bag, share them and redeem rewards. Approved Rewards proposal; 10% sales 5 yrs at +5 pts retention. 02 SpoonFull (data & reporting): Scans each tray to measure what residents ate, then recommends diet adjustments. ~$23K/yr Net operating savings; 15m → 10s Per intake record time reduction. 03 Lead Follow-up Reminder (automation): Reads the lead tracker and emails one weekly list of follow-ups, owners and actions. 93% Weekly review time reduction; ~$2.1K/yr Estimated savings, +$34/yr per lead. 04 HubSpot CRM Cleanup (data & reporting): Traces duplicate contacts, tags lead sources, fills missing addresses and reports daily. 324 → 22 Leads needing manual review; 395 Duplicates caught before import. 05 Paagi (automation): Recognizes an item and recommends the packaging and transport that fit it best. Champion SCS Days 2025 Hackathon; 72% Wasted box space reduction. 06 GabAI (applications): Predicts attention risk from screen-time habits, then nudges kids toward family quests. Free SNAP-IV-based screening; 130 hrs/yr Screen time reduction per child. 07 Portfolio Terminal Agent (automation): A retro terminal that answers visitors' questions about my work through an n8n RAG agent. 20 Question topics answered instantly; 14 Slash commands to move around. 08 End-to-End Test Automation (automation): End-to-end Cypress tests for a logistics platform's customer and employee portals. 18 End-to-end test suites; 2 User portals covered.
